name: sw_get
description: Reads the whole document. format: "latex" (default), "markdown", "json" (the editor's own format).

name: sw_outline
description: The document's blocks: for each, its number (index), kind, first words and formulas. Use it to find a block's number before changing that block.

name: sw_set
description: Replaces the whole document with LaTeX (a full document or just the body).

name: sw_insert
description: Inserts LaTeX (paragraphs, formulas, lists, theorems...) after block index; without index it goes at the end; index = -1 puts it at the start.

name: sw_find
description: Finds text (not inside formulas); returns the block number of each place.

name: sw_replace
description: Replaces the text find with with (not inside formulas); all = false replaces only the first.

name: sw_formulas
description: Lists all formulas (inline and displayed) with their block numbers.

name: sw_setFormula
description: Changes formula n (in the order formulas gives) to new LaTeX.

name: sw_open
description: Opens a file: in the desktop app give path (.sci or a 5.x .tex). Only files in the open document's folder, aiFolder (see info) and the folders the user allowed; anywhere else the user is asked first.

name: sw_save
description: Saves (desktop app): the main format is 5.x .tex (5.5 opens it); a path ending in .sci saves as .sci. Without path it saves back to the same file (keeping a .bak; an unchanged 5.x file is not rewritten; in an edited one only the edited parts are written again, the rest stays as it was in the file). Only .tex and .sci; saving outside the open document's folder, aiFolder (see info) and the folders the user allowed asks the user first.

name: sw_typeset
description: Typesets to PDF and opens it (desktop app). Returns pdf (its path) and errors (what TeX reported). With errors the PDF still comes out but those parts may be wrong, so fix them (the message gives the line of the TeX).

name: sw_info
description: The document's name, path, number of blocks and formulas, whether it was opened from 5.x, and aiFolder: the folder (Documents\opensw) where AI may always save, e.g. a new document, without asking.

name: sw_compute
description: Computes one formula with the chosen computation engine (SymPy or Mathematica, see Tools > Computation Engine), without changing the document. op: evaluate (default), numeric, simplify, expand, factor, combine, rewrite_exp, rewrite_sincos, solve, numericsolve, ode, odenumeric (Solve ODE > Numeric: a one-column matrix of equations (any order) and initial values y(0) = 1, y'(0) = 0; defines the solutions as functions, so y(1) can then be evaluated), check, partialfractions (params: [variable], when there are several), collect, differentiate, integrate, series, extrema, laplace, inverselaplace, fourier, determinant, inverse, transpose, eigenvalues, rank, rref, nullspace, trace, charpoly, adjugate, mean, median, variance, stddev, implicitdiff, integersolve, recursion (a one-column matrix: the recurrence and starting values), maximize, minimize, feasible, standardize, dual (simplex method: a one-column matrix, first row the objective, the other rows the constraints, all variables >= 0), gradient, divergence, curl, laplacian, hessian, jacobian, wronskian, potential, vectorpotential (params are the basis variables, default x, y, z), byparts (params: [u]), changevar (params: ["u=g(x)"]), approxint (params: [method, number of subintervals]; method is left, midpoint, right, trapezoid or simpson, in single quotes), iterate (params: [starting value, count]). Returns the result as LaTeX; solve, numericsolve, integersolve, ode, extrema, maximize, minimize return a list of solutions.

name: sw_select
description: Puts the cursor in block block.

name: sw_focusEnd
description: Puts the cursor at the end of the document.
